notes.title: I want my key and the Unmissable Prize
notes.content: Another combo promotion happening! For those who want to learn about the game Darklands: The Chapters and participate in this promotion, it is very easy. Anyone who wants a free game key just send an email to issedonestudios@sapo.pt with the phrase "I want my key!". The keys will be made available until March 30, 2024. Those who like the game, the first 10 positive reviews will win the "Unmissable" Community Prize on their Profile. Take advantage of the opportunity and participate!

notes.title: Take a Review, Get a Gift from the Community
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We're running an event where you give a positive review of our new game Darklands: The Chapters, and you get a community gift, The Mind Blast, worth 1200 Steam Points (Applied to Steam Profile). To participate is very easy!! The first 11 to play/like the game must send a POSITIVE review to win the prize. I will award in order of call. The winners will be announced here in the community.

If you would like to receive a free key to play and participate in the promotion, simply send an email to issedonestudios@sapo.pt with the title "Mental Explosion", and I will also answer in order of call.

If you wrote the positive review but didn't make it in time to win the prize, don't worry. We will give you 5 game keys as a gift to give to whoever you want.

Thank you all!


Livy Arthur

notes.title: I want my Key!
notes.content: Hi, we have news! Darklands: The Chapters. There is a FREE key for everyone. Promotion valid until the end of Carnival, 13/02 at 11:59 pm. Send an email to: issedonestudios@sapo.pt with the title "I want my Key!". Give it a go guys! Thank you all!
